collection.networkMethod: Official public HTTPS Git sparse fixed commit after official REST rights/commit metadata verification. Only selected color/svg files; no Git hooks, source JS, LFS, PNG or video. robots access evidence retained. No credentials or accounts added.

dedupe.method: Canonical geometry strips paint/style/timing for exact and high same-tree checks. Alpha64 overlap covers8 rotations/reflections against baseline+new sources and within source. All full candidate source artworks were inspected; nearest and semantic/alias prompts were inspected with actual originals including completed animation frames. Shared external circles/rectangles were resolved by internal components and purpose, not auto-deleted as identical. Complete composition, not publisher name, is the novelty unit. Minor paint/style/pose/direction/number/repeated-part/crop/state/basic-UI families conservatively excluded.
dedupe.limitations: Bounded corpus-relative review. Numeric outer-silhouette candidates are prompts, not identity proofs; some shared-frame candidates are grouped by the same frame rather than falsely counted as unique visual identities. No claim of universal uniqueness or projected remaining supply.
